title: Ext universe transport commutes with the abelian h-map
statement: For schemes X,Y, g:Y to X, modules F,G, phi:F to g_*G and degree q, moduleAbelianUniverseMap [def-pbc-module-abelian-universe-equiv] commutes with the abelian Ext h-map defined by invImage(g), constIso(g).symm and coeff(g,phi) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]: its value after the small-Ext map equals zariskiModuleHMap(g,phi,q) [def-pbc-qcoherent-zariski-cohomology-map] applied after universe change. The input is an arbitrary small abelian Ext class; no module-cohomology map or resolution equivalence occurs.

source.place: Tag 03FD; canonical change of universe Ext.chgUniv and its exact-functor compatibility

proof.text: Unfold the cached universe maps. Apply the generic-site universe-transport identity for the composite of exact inverse image and coefficient postcomposition; its proof uses coherentSheafUniverseEquiv_naturality, Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom and Ext.homEquiv_chgUniv. Then apply zariskiModuleHMap_formula to identify the explicit large-Ext composite with the recorded Zariski h-map.

from.place: Ext universe transport commutes with the abelian h-map extracted from lem-pbc-module-abelian-hmap.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleAbelianUniverseMap_hmap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward g).obj G)
    (q : ℕ) (x : H F q) :
    moduleAbelianUniverseMap Y G q
      (Sheaf.H.map (coeff g φ) q
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) q x)) =
      zariskiModuleHMap g φ q (moduleAbelianUniverseMap X F q x)
